title: A bit of Fable 5 with Ultracode, an 8-sentence prompt, 14 minutes of waiting time and finally...
author: _AssetSmithy_
selftext: Yes, Fable 5 really is a masterpiece. I wanted to try it out too, since a lot of people use it to create small browser games. An 8-sentence prompt - 'Please build me Tank Battle City from 1990.' - and boom, THE game of my childhood \^\^

comments.author: Nasdali
comments.body: Yes! Fable for retro style games has become my new favourite hobby.

comments.author: Orlandogameschool
comments.body: I think we are going to see a resurgence of old school loooking games with deep gameplay keep working on this op!

replies.author: jack_cheng2020
replies.body: But let me ask you guys a serious question: What’s the actual point of using Fable 5 to remake ancient games?

replies.author: Orlandogameschool
replies.body:
For me personally it’s simple….money and business. 

It’s literally a safe business model to take mechanics and genres from retro games and inject 2026 tech into them

I’m not talking about stealing ip or copywriting. 

I’m talking about making a mobile dig dug clone   
with a twist a multi player bomber man clone with a twist , shit last night I was thinking damn I used to love playing the Simpsons arcade game let’s start working on a 4 player coop beat em up.

replies.author: jack_cheng2020
replies.body: Haha, respect the hustle! Honestly, adding a modern twist to classic games is a super solid idea. Wishing you make some good money with it. Go get 'em!

replies.author: _AssetSmithy_
replies.body: Personally I don't build games, for me it was just a test of what Fable can one-shot. I only create 2D assets for games.
